primary_reference: F2F_BRANCH_COMPATIBILITY_REPORT.md in the current research worktree
f2g_reference: F2G_FINAL_REPORT.md in the current research worktree
interpretation_of_commit: First checked post-training commit with content-matched frozen G13 core files; not proof of the exact Git HEAD or every runner byte during the 2026-10-14 training process.
unfrozen_runner_caveat: The executed historical g13_train.py bytes were not recorded in the pre-training freeze. This commit's runner was audited but cannot be declared byte-identical to the original process.

observation_layout.0_to_9: five normalized projected guidewire tracking points (2D each)
observation_layout.14_to_16: three normalized distal signed centerline-radius clearance proxies
observation_layout.17_to_18: projected distal wire-versus-vessel tangent sine and cosine
observation_layout.19: distal bend angle divided by pi

action_layout: normalized insertion/translation and axial rotation, each clipped to [-1,1] and mapped to JShaped limits
model_and_planner: 256D latent, five Q networks, 101-bin value/reward, H=3, six MPPI iterations, 512 candidates, 64 elites, 24 policy-prior trajectories; ordinary task reward plus terminal Q score, no contact-cost MPPI term
objective: Original raw TargetReached + 0.01 PathLengthDelta task reward and original G13 TD-MPC2 losses plus lambda_force_train=0.5 next-latent force-head Huber loss. The auxiliary loss backpropagates through the shared encoder and dynamics.
force_telemetry: Validated passive Generic G2 3 mm distal force reconstruction; G13 force-head target is next-control-interval maximum substep nominal N, while the environment also reports interval FTI in nominal N*s.
remaining_provenance_limits: Exact historical training-time runner bytes and process Git HEAD were not SHA-frozen.
Exact historical SOFA/BeamAdapter binary identity was not recorded.
No original mid-episode physical scene snapshot exists at step 260000.
